hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.py) cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && uv run ruff check --fix "$f" 2>&1; uv run ruff format "$f" 2>&1;; esac; true

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *src/*.py|*tests/*) cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && out=$(uv run pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider 2>&1); rc=$?; tail=$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -3); if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then echo "PYTEST FAILED: $tail"; else printf '%s\n' "$tail"; fi;; esac; true

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in */config.csv) exit 0;; */data/*) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"data/ is read-only, hand-collected corpus input (see CLAUDE.md): publisher exports, PDFs, the enrichment cache and the .lake_research_map archive are never edited by Claude. Only the config.csv search reports remain editable."}}';; esac

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); blocked=0; echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '\brm\b' && echo "$cmd" | grep -qE -- '-[a-zA-Z]*[rf][a-zA-Z]*[rf][a-zA-Z]*(\s|$)' && echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '\bdata\b' && blocked=1; echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '\bgit\s+push\b' && echo "$cmd" | grep -qE -- '--force($|[^-])' && blocked=1; echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '\bgit\s+reset\s+--hard\b' && blocked=1; if [ "$blocked" = "1" ]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Blocked destructive command pattern (rm -rf data, git push --force, or git reset --hard). This project treats data/ as irreplaceable manual input and main as a protected branch."}}'; fi
